issues: No prior stories existed for FEAT-4; initializing baseline set
notes: Stories created covering schema, core logic, API integration, and testing aligned to provider_detail_service and facade usage.

STORY-FEAT4-001.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema
STORY-FEAT4-001.description: Create structured schema for provider detail output including NPI data fields, state board links, and research URLs to ensure consistent downstream consumption.

STORY-FEAT4-002.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
STORY-FEAT4-002.description: Build core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider details, and normalize fields for internal use.

STORY-FEAT4-003.title: Construct External Provider Links
STORY-FEAT4-003.description: Generate state medical board verification links and research site URLs based on provider metadata (state, name, identifiers).

STORY-FEAT4-004.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
STORY-FEAT4-004.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and expose as a callable tool for chat workflows.

STORY-FEAT4-005.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
STORY-FEAT4-005.description: Create tests validating NPI lookup, response formatting, link generation, and facade integration including error handling scenarios.

FEAT-4.mitigation: Use existing provider_detail_service patterns and validated CMS API integration already present in codebase.
